result.title: AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents
result.summary: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines. We demonstrate the framework across agentic tasks including legal contract search and domain-specific applications, illustrating its use for trajectory-based optimization, tool-use evaluation, and cross-task agent development. AgentTune is released as a source-available library at https://github.com/Lexsi-Labs/AgentTune

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AgentTune，一个面向工具调用 LLM agent 的开源 Python 库，用两层 EventLog 统一表示 agent 轨迹，并整合共享运行时、工具调用 RL、蒸馏、RAG、评估与自愈等组件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「轨迹统一表示＋可投影到训练/评估」的设计，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、监督与贡献分配提供工程线索，但该库针对纯文本工具 agent，与 latent 视觉状态是否兼容有待核查。
